critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/admin_documents.py L38-43 — DOC_ALLOWED_TYPES correctly restricts to PDF+JPG. size guard 20MB returns 413. `_escape_regex` prevents regex injection in ?q=. All-good.
backend/routers/admin_documents.py L81 — `find(..., {'_id': 0}).sort('created_at', -1)` returns descending order (newest first) and excludes MongoDB ObjectId — good serialization hygiene.
backend/routers/admin_documents.py L147-150 — best-effort blob delete via try/except is intentional for orphan storage-blob resilience. OK.

frontend DocumentsManager.jsx L46-54 — Client-side filter mirrors backend regex (title + note + original_filename). Both client-only filter AND ?q= would work if the front-end passed q — currently front-end filters CLIENT-SIDE only, but the review spec says both are acceptable. Since list is capped at 5000 (backend .to_list(5000)) the client-side approach is fine.

frontend AdminStudentDetail.jsx L284-331 — AgbSection cleanly composed from two AgbRows with proper testids + disabled state when email missing. Uses `student.agb_student_sent_at || student.agb_sent_at` fallback so legacy sends still register — matches spec.

frontend TermsManager stat chips — 'Bestätigt N · Gesendet N · Offen N' correctly derived from student-side timestamps (agb_student_confirmed_at with agb_confirmed_at fallback). Reflects the semantic that ONLY the student's confirmation gates the acceptance state.
frontend DocumentsManager.jsx L221-227 — Client-side type + size guard before POST duplicates server-side validation → nice UX, avoids upload of oversized files. OK.

test_iteration51_split_agb_documents.py::test_send_guardian_fails_without_guardian_email SKIPS when all existing students already have guardian_email — this can happen after other tests populate the fixture. The new test_iteration51_extra.py version CREATES a fresh student without guardian_email so the 400 path is always exercised. Recommend removing the SKIP fallback in the older file or letting the extra version supersede it.
